_doc: Config for scripts/models/process.py. Material patterns are case-insensitive regexes on part names; first match wins. rotate_deg (Blender axes) turns the user-facing side to +Z (glTF front). Materials per Ansh 2026-10-22: carbon base plate, black plastic grips/enclosure/buttons/dials, stainless centre bolts, gold anodised aluminium quick disconnect. The unnamed 2026-01-12-* parts are the electrical team's board (black soldermask, photo 16CBD5D0) and its components; hidden in the assembled build, shown in steering-wheel-parts.
